hints.title: Full Round Modulo Reduction
hints.text: One complete round consumes sum(chalk) chalk units; reduce k via k modulo sum(chalk).

hints.title: Simulate Final Single Round
hints.text: Iterate through students sequentially from index 0, comparing remaining chalk with current student requirement.

hints.title: First Insufficient Index
hints.text: Return student index i as soon as k is strictly smaller than chalk[i].

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating full rounds unit by unit without modulo causes time limit exceeded for k up to 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Taking k modulo sum(chalk) reduces the problem to at most one linear pass in O(n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate reduces k by total chalk sum before looping.
